en: Sepia-toned historic view of a rural railway station complex labeled "Jernvägsstationen Mjöbäck." In the foreground are fields and trees framing a cluster of wooden buildings, including a main station house with a gabled roof and white-trimmed windows, smaller outbuildings, and railway tracks with carriages. People appear gathered near a platform area with an awning. Low forested hills rise in the background, giving the scene a countryside feel. Printed caption text is visible along the upper right portion of the image.
